v-01: I have to pump it a few times before it bites, and the soft feeling is worst on the first stop of the morning. The warning light stays off.
v-02: The squeal starts when I touch the pedal gently at low speed, and the grinding shows up in the last few metres before I stop.
v-03: It pulls left only when I brake hard from around 60, and the steering wheel tugs in my hands. Going straight with light braking it is fine.
v-04: Yes, the pedal is firm after a drive but goes soft if the car sits overnight, and it takes two or three pumps to firm up again.
v-05: It happens mostly under load going up a hill. I feel a lurch, then the engine note jumps before the next gear catches. No warning light.
v-06: It is a hard bump, like the car kicks forward, when I shift from reverse into drive at idle. It happens cold and warm, every time.
v-07: Yes, it stays in third and the revs go up but the car does not speed up. It happens on flat roads too, and the dash shows no light.
v-08: Yes, the gear letter flashes on the dash and the car crawls at about 40 with no power. The engine light is on too, and it is solid.
v-09: It drops to the floor when I push it and stays there, and I have to pump it up again before I can change gear. It started last week.
v-10: I hear a crunch like metal on metal when I push the stick towards second, and it only goes in after I wait a few seconds with the clutch down.
v-11: Yes, the revs climb but the car barely moves when I take off on a hill, and I smell something hot after a few tries. No light on.
v-12: The shudder is strongest in the first few metres and worse when the engine is cold. I feel it through the seat and the floor. The light is off.
v-13: Just a single loud click from under the bonnet, and the dash lights go dim when I turn the key. The radio does not come on either.
v-14: The engine turns slow and lazy on cold mornings, but after a jump start it spins fine all day. The dash lights stay bright when I try.
v-15: The battery light flickers on at about 2000 rpm and sometimes stays on until I turn the lights off. Headlights look a bit dim at idle.
v-16: The dash lights and headlights are bright, but when I turn the key the engine does nothing at all, with no click and no sound.
v-17: The whole car vibrates through the seat and steering wheel at idle, and the revs bounce up and down in neutral at the lights.
v-18: It dies when I bring the car to a stop, and it leaves the warning lights on. It happens mostly on warm days with the aircon running.
v-19: Blue smoke comes out the back for about thirty seconds after a cold start, and it smells oily. It clears up once the car warms.
v-20: It feels flat and sluggish going up hills, with the revs climbing but the speed dropping. Flat roads feel fine, and there is no warning light.
v-21: The needle creeps up to just under the red when I sit in traffic with the aircon on, then drops back when I get moving again.
v-22: I smell something sweet after parking, and there is a small wet puddle under the front on the passenger side with a greenish tint.
v-23: The little oil can light flickers on at idle and goes off when I rev a bit. It has happened twice this week, both times in traffic.
v-24: It puffs out from under the bonnet when I pull up after a long highway run, and the temp needle sits near the middle, not in the red.
v-25: The shake starts at about 95 and gets stronger until 100. I feel it in the steering wheel and in the seat, and it is smooth at 80.
v-26: The wheel is very hard to turn when I am parking at walking pace, and it gets easier once I am moving above 30.
v-27: A high whine comes from the front when I turn the wheel to full lock on the left, and it stops when I straighten up. It is louder when cold.
v-28: I can turn the wheel about a quarter turn before the car responds, and it feels loose when I drive straight at highway speed.
v-29: A clunk from the front, like something knocking, every time I hit a bump. It is louder at low speed and sounds similar on both sides.
v-30: A rattle and bounce from the back over speed humps, and the rear feels like it drops and comes back up. It happens with a load on too.
v-31: A buzzing vibration in the seat starts around 80 and stays until about 100, and I feel it more in my lower back than anywhere else.
v-32: The wobble comes on around 110, mainly in the steering, and it fades when I lift off the throttle down to 90 or lower.
v-33: The 4WD light flashes on the dash when I try to switch, and the car stays in 2WD even after I push the shift lever. The engine is running.
v-34: A grinding noise from under the car when I shift into 4WD, then a whine that lasts a few seconds, mostly when the car is rolling.
v-35: A single clunk when I lift off the throttle and again when I get back on it, more noticeable on rough tracks in 4WD high range.
v-36: The shift lever is stiff, and when I force it there is a horrible scraping and grinding noise, especially when I move it while stopped.
v-37: The air blows lukewarm even with the dial on max cold, and the fan is loud. I get the same result on recirculate.
v-38: A damp musty smell comes through the vents, mainly in the first few minutes after I switch the fan on during a cold morning.
v-39: Only the passenger side gets warm air. The driver side stays cool even when I set both sides to hot, and the fan speed is fine.
v-40: The fan only blows on the top speed. Settings one, two and three do nothing, and I hear no change in the noise at all.
v-41: The indicator clicks much faster than normal, flashing like a double-speed tick on both sides. The brake lights work fine.
v-42: The window goes down fine, but when I press up it stops halfway with a whirring noise. I have to hold the switch to get it moving again.
v-43: The speedo needle jumps up and down while I am driving, and the fuel needle sits on empty even after I filled up a full tank.
v-44: When I press lock on the remote, only the driver door clicks. The rest of the central locking does nothing, but unlocking from inside works.
v-45: The airbag light on the dash stays solid all the time, and it has been on since I started the car this morning.
v-46: The ABS light and the brake light glow together on the dash, and the brake pedal feels normal when I press it.
v-47: The seatbelt chime keeps going even though the buckle is clicked in, and it happens with the driver belt and the passenger belt.
v-48: The airbag light flashes for a few seconds when I turn the key, then goes off. It happens every cold start, never while I am driving.
